column1: # DO NOT hand-edit: a hand pin belongs in gen_data.GLOBAL_RECOVER, where it is visible
# as one. Rows here are DERIVED -- `source` says from what.
#   observed = an MSB/check_maps map for the flag
#   item_coords = an exact item entity in item_grace_coords.tsv
#   event_call = a map EMEVD initializer carrying the flag and its item lot
#   talk_esd = the flag's item lot is awarded by exactly ONE map's talk ESD
# A flag whose evidence names MORE THAN ONE map is absent on purpose (NPCs relocate;
# picking one would assert a reachability we do not have). So is a flag with no
# evidence at all. Hand-confirmed exceptions belong in GLOBAL_RECOVER instead.
